spec_rule: Part 7 Customer Demand: Pre-Seed=Expected when demand validation is reasonably possible; Seed=Expected until realized Traction supersedes; Series A+=N/A when realized Traction is the correct downstream evidence -- determined by actual company maturity and evidence state, never mechanically by the financing-round label alone. Two-part maturity test used below (per spec text): (1) no disclosed customer/revenue data, and (2) single-market/pre-scale.
note: Score itself never changes for any company here -- Customer Demand had no scoreable demand-validation evidence for ANY of the 15 companies either before or after this review. The only possible change is the evidence_status label (optional_unavailable/N/A-equivalent vs. expected_unavailable/diligence-flagged), which is arithmetically identical in pillar-score terms (both states are excluded from the scored set) but differs in diligence-flag severity.

No dimension score changed for any company; no pillar score changed for any company; diligence_flag_count increases by 1 for each of the 3 reclassified companies.
